label: US travellers who used AI on at least one trip
question: Have most travellers now used AI for a trip?
answer: 56% of US travellers used AI for planning, booking or in-destination help on at least one trip in the past twelve months, up from 43% six months earlier and 33% the half-year before that.
sample: US travellers; The AI Surge: Travel's Fastest Behavioral Shift in a Decade, published March 2026
methodology: Phocuswright, The AI Surge: Travel's Fastest Behavioral Shift in a Decade, published March 2026. US travellers; waves 1H25, 2H25 and 1H26. Among travellers who have used AI at all, 94% have used it for travel.
